in_hebrew.name: Orin
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Orin הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Orin was a god of the mountains and a hunter. His name derives from the Greek word oros, meaning 'mountain'. In Christian context, Orin can be seen as a symbol of strength and endurance, representing the spiritual journey up the mountain of life.
